# triOS College

> > triOS College is a Canadian career college offering diploma programs and online learning with industry partnerships across Ontario campuses.

triOS College provides career-focused training and diploma programs through both in-person and online formats, with campuses in major Ontario cities including Toronto, Brampton, Hamilton, Kitchener, London, Mississauga, Ottawa, St. Catharines, and Windsor. The college emphasizes modular learning, employer collaboration, and comprehensive career services to support student success and job placement.

## Key Topics

- triOS College
- Career training and diploma programs
